description: What we hold about ONE city: the text of its guide with its highlights, its history and a few facts, the weather month by month, its photo and its position. Give the city by name. Only the parts we hold are in the reply, and not_held names the parts we hold nothing for (out of guide, history, climate, photo, position): do not fill a part that is not held from anywhere else. Every text is returned exactly as we publish it, so quote it and do not restate it. climate.months has twelve entries, January first, each with the average daily high and low in degrees Celsius, the rain in millimetres and a one-word condition; climate.source is the credit that must be shown with it. photo.url is our own photo of that city. trips.count is the number of trips find_trips finds for the city: use find_trips for the trips themselves, with their dates and prices. No hotel price is given here. A name we hold nothing for, and a country, is refused with city_not_found.

city.description: The name of one city, in English or in any language we publish (e.g. "Vienna", "Wien"). Letter case and accents do not matter.

name: get_city
